title: Reporting Address, Income and Household Changes
content:
## Reporting a new address, income or household

**Desk rule — Medicaid Managed Care Membership.** The state eligibility system is the only source of a member's address, income and household. When a member reports a new address, income or household change, Prairie Ridge records it as a plan change request of the address change report type or the income change report type, with the request status "forwarded to state eligibility", and does not change the member profile or the membership itself. The reported change reaches the membership only through a later state enrollment file income update, and the member is reminded that the report must reach the state within the category's change report days of the change. A notice channel preference is not a reportable change and is updated directly on the membership.

### Condition — handling — effect

| What the member reports | How Prairie Ridge records it | Effect on the profile and membership now |
|---|---|---|
| New address | Plan change request, address change report, forwarded to state eligibility | None until a later state file |
| New income | Plan change request, income change report, forwarded to state eligibility | None until a later state file carries the income update |
| Household change | Plan change request of one of the two report types above, forwarded to state eligibility | None until a later state file |
| New notice channel preference | Not a reportable change | Updated directly on the membership |

### Points of judgement

- **Who changes the address or income on file?** Only the state eligibility system; the change appears on the membership when a later state file brings it.
- **What is the member told?** That the report must reach the state within the category's change report days of the change.
- **Is a notice channel preference forwarded to the state?** No; it is not a reportable change and is updated directly on the membership.
